reason: Almost $30 for a month of magnesium is more than the Toplux or Goli I already look at, and I wait for sales anyway. The $24.99 launch price is still above what I pay now, so I would not buy it this week.
objection: I can get a month of magnesium for $19 to $23, so paying $25 to $30 for the same thing in a foil sachet feels like paying for the packaging.
would_change_my_mind: A price near $19 a box, or a coupon or flash sale that brings two boxes under $40.
